summary: Every round-5 story note is closed on the sheets, and the last act now lands. (1) The 'dark lantern' finally has its proof in the narration. L1504b ('Snuff that plan out, and it rhymes with "habit" instead.') sits between 'rabbit' and 'Nobody told it to plan'. On the ch15-s03 sheet the snuffer covers RABBIT by +13.62, HABIT lights on 'habit' (+14.29), the echo caption comes only after it (+15.46), and the slugs are done before 'plan'. A first-time viewer now sees an intervention and its result, not a word swapping for no reason, so ch15-s08's 'One lantern is still dark' is earned. (2) The crest of Hinton's 36-year arc now has him in it. He is asleep on the pillow from +6.79. The handset is dark at +9.33, just before 'phone', and lit by +10.37. His head is lifted by +10.67, and the GEOFFREY HINTON card follows. The medallion push now names both prize ideas (HOPFIELD NET · 1982 on 'downhill', BOLTZMANN MACHINE · 1983–85 on 'cools'), and the citation ribbon is gone before the push. (3) The final STATUS: OPEN is centred on the CASE FILE face in full red (+13.92, +15.25), so the last and loudest of the three stamps is no longer the faintest. The match is now struck by an articulated hand on 'new', and the candle catches on 'candles'. (4) ch14-s07's double exposure is gone: the 'liang' hand-off at +7.50 is one opaque shelf mid-pull-back, the tags are cleared and the quote is not yet up. The film's spine is the strongest I have seen in this pipeline: one case question, three suspects, and a candle clock that turns 'how long people believed it' into a duration you can see. Around a dozen 'put that in the file' plants each come back (the ChatGPT flaw becomes 'plausible, and sometimes wrong'; Rosenblatt's 1961 language note becomes 'language was the door'; the AlexNet waiting note becomes the scaling law; Lenat's 'practically nothing' comes back; 'why choose the fog?' is answered; the dinner bet; Widrow; the Helsinki student; Versailles; the three-stamp rule). What keeps it below 9.5: the film runs 36.1 min (2168 s, 103% of the 35-min ceiling), and the present-day news run (ch14-s01 to ch15-s05, about 4.5 min) is still the densest and least felt stretch. It reads as headlines between two emotional peaks, though it flows into a moving close. One thread the ear hears is never paid off aloud: Turing's 'educate a child machine' (L0212) plants the case question in 1950, but its only return is the silent Turing epigraph on the credits.

issues.problem: Turing's 'not to program a grown-up mind, but to educate a child machine' (L0212, 1950) is the first time anyone in the film asks the case's own question. The story-editor rounds re-wrote it for exactly that reason. The ear never hears it come back. The verdict line L1527 ('Who taught it? Not rules alone. Not knowledge, typed in by hand. Learning, with its accomplices...') answers the question without naming who first proposed the answer. The only return is the silent 'Alan Turing, 1950' epigraph on the credits card (ch15-s10 +0.92 to +6.67), which most viewers will read as decoration, not as a payoff. This is the one plant in an unusually well-paid-off film that the narration leaves loose.

issues.problem: Pacing across the whole runtime: the film is 36.1 min (2168 s), above the brief's 30-35 min target (the reference ran 35:37). ch14-s01 to ch15-s05 (1770-2042 s, about 4.5 min) is a run of headline facts: the 2017 plan, the fence, DeepSeek's price, reasoning models, market drop, talent, Bletchley/dialogue, the gap, then the Nobel, interpretability, METR, and four lab-news items in ch15-s05 (38.75 s). Each beat is fair and sourced. Emotionally it is the flattest stretch, between the Hinton-recants peak (ch13) and the close (ch15-s06 to s10). That run is carried by the candle and stamp motifs, not by stakes the viewer feels.
issues.fix: No re-cut this round. The fairness balance in ch14/ch15-s05 is hard won, and every reviewer has signed off on it. best_moments: ch01-s01 / ch15-s09: the film opens on a lone cyan cursor in a dark room and closes on the same pinprick. A neighbour's lamp comes on, a paper-cut hand strikes a match on 'new', and a fresh candle catches on 'candles'. A true bookend.

ch01-s06 / ch15-s08: the silent rewind montage (Go stone, GPU fans, snow, the Mark I knob, the lantern) carries us to 'World War Two'. Thirty-four minutes later the same images fast-forward, and the case board rewires itself into a network: 'The board was a network all along.'

ch02-s04 / L0209: 'Each belief gets one, burning as long as it was held.' One rule turns 80 years of opinion into a bar chart in wax. It pays off in 'Some candles burned nearly forty years; some, two; one match, a day.'
ch04-s05: 'In 1971, on his forty-third birthday, Frank Rosenblatt drowned while sailing.' Still the film's best quiet beat.
ch06-s05 to ch07-s01: 'So who paid for dinner? Keep that question.' ... 'Both men. Each man lost one bet.'
ch08-s12 / L0823: the error drops 10.9 points, and the narrator says only 'A cliff.'
ch08-s13b: 'Why choose the fog?' The learned stencils come out of the fog, and Hinton, 'thirty-six years near the edge of the light', is reached by it: 'Now, it found him.'
ch12-s06: 'Not a new engine. A new door.' One warm window in a city of cold ones, and the first note in the case file comes back the same day.

ch15-s01 (new this round): Hinton asleep in a California hotel room, the handset lighting cool white and his head lifting toward it. Then a cut to the Nobel hall, where Hopfield's Versailles talk that 'nobody remembered' is paid off 25 minutes after it was planted, and the medallion names HOPFIELD NET and BOLTZMANN MACHINE as the push lands.

ch15-s03 (new this round): 'Snuff that plan out, and it rhymes with "habit" instead. Nobody told it to plan.' A brass snuffer drops on one lantern under a microscope, and the film's only look inside the dark lantern becomes an experiment a child could follow.
ch15-s07: Widrow's lantern in a snowy window, 'never got over it'. 'Remember him' is paid off 32 minutes after it was planted.

ch14-s07 → ch15-s08 → ch15-s09: three STATUS: OPEN stamps (fence, how far / how fast, the case file), rising in loudness and now all legible, while the verdict slip LEARNING + ACCOMPLICES / NEVER ONE PERSON closes the one question the film can answer.
